­👤 gus (146.1K) 🗓1d 👁️49.8K
I got access to the @tryKumo private beta a week ago.

I had been looking for a way off my Mac mini because maintenance was a headache: updates in the middle of a run, heat in a small room, no space left on the desk, random downtime overnight.

I was running a small fleet of coding agents on it that were working on a side project while I was offline.

So Kumo is what I tried instead.

I started a VM, set up my agent swarm, closed the laptop and surprisingly in the morning the agents were still running with context intact and zero downtime.

It runs on kumo OS, which is AI production ready so I didn't have to install my stack for hours.

It also picks the cheapest combination of live electricity and GPU, which is interesting for big teams.

Needless to say, I'm going to list my Mac mini... Show more
